name: plan_id
label: Plan ID
help: The Plan ID returned by Plan an article.

name: answers
label: Answers
help: Your answers to the plan's questions, up to three.

name: headline
label: Headline
help: A headline to use instead of the plan's.

name: notes
label: Notes
help: Anything else the writer should know.

name: pictures
label: Cover picture
help: Designs a cover picture for the article, using image credits.

name: inside_pictures
label: Inside pictures
help: Number of pictures to place inside the article, from 0 to 3.

name: tone
label: Tone
help: For example friendly or professional. Left empty, the plan's tone.
